description.zh: 阿里云容器服务Kubernetes版的Kubernetes集群的ID。ClusterType为ask或one时，必填。
description.en: The ID of the Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster. This parameter is required when the ClusterType parameter is set to ask or one.
The cluster type. Valid values: ask, ecs, and one.
The ID of the resource group to which the Prometheus instance belongs.
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the cluster resides.

descriptions.zh: 只适用于ASK、ECS和ACKOne集群，集群已安装过托管版Prometheus。
descriptions.en: This operation is available only for ASK, ECS, and ACK One clusters. Before you call this operation, make sure that a managed Prometheus agent is installed for your cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms uninstall-managed-prometheus --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --cluster-type ask --vpc-id vpc-rpn0000000000 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms UninstallManagedPrometheus --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxyexli20000' --VpcId 'vpc-rpn0000000000' --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClusterType ask
